datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators at sub-national administrative units in Zambia on a roughly monthly basis throughout 2014. Spatial data were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing near-term projection scenarios, with attributes including classification scale, collection date, scenario type, and IPC value per unit. The dataset supports monitoring of food crisis severity and geographic extent for humanitarian response planning.

sources.name: FEWS NET
